lines.zh: 我一边走一边发出笑声
lines.en: I walk along making a laughing sound
My laughter arrives before my steps
I walk along the base of your wall

lines.zh: 每走一步，笑声就低一点
lines.en: Each step, the laughter drops a little
The lights flicker where I pass
I drag my feet along slowly
I walk as if waiting for you to turn

lines.zh: 笑声从我的位置一直延伸
lines.en: The laughter stretches from where I am
I go around what lies on the ground

lines.zh: 我的脚步和笑声不在同一拍
lines.en: My steps and my laughter are not in the same beat

lines.zh: 我从走廊这头笑到那头
lines.en: I laugh from one end of the corridor to the other

lines.zh: 我一边笑一边回头看你
lines.en: I laugh and look back at you
I stop, and the laughter goes on
You are not laughing, I am disappointed
I press the laughter down very low

lines.zh: 我在听你会不会跟着笑
lines.en: I am listening to see if you laugh along
The laughter turns in my throat
I do not need to open my mouth

lines.zh: 我站着，整个房子在回音
lines.en: I stand and the whole house echoes
My voice bounces off the walls
I wait, laughing very softly
Only I understand this joke
I stop mid-laugh and wait for you
I lean on the door frame laughing
I am counting how many steps you have left

lines.zh: 我笑得屋檐上有灰落下
lines.en: I laugh and dust falls from the eaves
Why are you not laughing at all
I have been telling it so long
Your expression is very interesting
Now, let me hear you laugh
What you hear is me

lines.zh: 这笑声是从你身后来的
lines.en: This laughter comes from behind you
You are counting how many times I laughed
I cannot stop laughing
What part do you not find funny
I have waited long for you to laugh

lines.zh: 你不笑，我就再大声一点
lines.en: If you do not laugh, I will get louder

lines.zh: 我们之间的笑话还没讲完
lines.en: The joke between us is not finished
Your ears have gone red

lines.zh: 你在想是不是自己听错了
lines.en: You are wondering if you misheard

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开了，声音从里面出来
lines.en: I opened my mouth and the sound came out
Look, I do not need to breathe either

lines.zh: 这个房间的回音很配合
lines.en: The echo in this room is very cooperative
Do you understand now
You tremble when I laugh
I will tell you the last part
The laughter caught for a moment
I stopped for half a second, then laughed again
That was not funny
My voice has gone hoarse
You have cut my joke short
The pain leaves me unable to laugh
I bend over and the laughter becomes panting
Such small damage, very funny
I laugh until I am shaking

lines.zh: 我记下来了，这个也要讲
lines.en: I noted it, this goes in the telling too

lines.zh: 你不该用这个来堵我的嘴
lines.en: You should not use that to plug my mouth
I shake my head while laughing
This cannot be eaten, nor heard
You hold it up, and I still laugh
My laughter has grown louder
You have made food into a weapon
I am not hungry, I only want to laugh
Put it away, let us go on
This is not funny at all
Your arm must be tired

lines.zh: 你撞过来，笑声断了一下
lines.en: You bumped me, the laughter broke once
Then it grew louder

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我还在笑
lines.en: We collided and I am still laughing

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到了我的胸口
lines.en: Your shoulder met my chest

lines.zh: 我退了一步，笑声跟着退
lines.en: I stepped back, and the laughter with me
You bump me, I laugh at you
This does not hurt at all, it is funny

lines.zh: 我的笑声在墙间弹了两次
lines.en: My laughter bounced twice between the walls

lines.zh: 你被自己的动作逗笑了吗
lines.en: Did your own movement make you laugh
I laugh until I bend over

lines.zh: 这个话题让我笑得更厉害
lines.en: That topic makes me laugh harder
Just laugh once

lines.zh: 这个笑话没有第二个人
lines.en: This joke has no second person
I have laughed alone for a long time

lines.zh: 你说的话我记下来了，很好笑
lines.en: I have noted what you said, very funny
I cannot give birth to that
Laughter is my offspring
What a funny question
I go on laughing for you
I pick it up and laugh
This shape is very funny
What you dropped looks like a clown
I shake it a little

lines.zh: 它响了一声，我笑得更响
lines.en: It made a sound and I laughed louder
My name is a single blank space.
I will keep this to tell about
I laugh and throw it away

lines.zh: 这一点也不好笑，但我还在笑
lines.en: This is not funny, but I am still laughing
You are heading that way
I follow, laughing as I go

lines.zh: 你的方向让笑话更好笑
lines.en: Your direction makes the joke funnier
I am ready to tell the next one
You looked back, good

lines.zh: 这个距离我能讲得很清楚
lines.en: At this distance I can tell it clearly
I start laughing, very loudly
It is funnier when you run
You are inside my joke's reach
Do not rush, the punchline is coming
The direction you took suits me well

lines.zh: 我把笑声提前放到你要去的地方
lines.en: I put my laughter ahead where you are going

lines.zh: 你停住，我的笑声贴着墙过来。
lines.en: You stop; my laughter slides along the wall.
I watch the back of your neck

lines.zh: 这栋房子开始配合我了
lines.en: This house is starting to work with me

lines.zh: 我们去找个更小的房间
lines.en: Let us find a smaller room
I follow you laughing the whole way
You covered your ears
I cannot hear you clearly that way

lines.zh: 我的笑声在你前面等着
lines.en: My laughter is waiting ahead of you
The more you run, the more I laugh

lines.zh: 这栋房子的每一面墙都在笑
lines.en: Every wall of this house is laughing

lines.zh: 你数不出声音是从哪里来的
lines.en: You cannot tell where the sound comes from
I am on the other side of your corner
The laughter is getting closer
You are starting to laugh, are you not
I follow, one laugh per step

lines.zh: 你回头的时候我正好在笑
lines.en: I was laughing right when you turned

lines.zh: 声音从三个方向传过来
lines.en: The sound comes from three directions
You chose the longer path
I will be waiting there

lines.zh: 你听见的笑声里有你自己的
lines.en: Some of the laughter you hear is your own

lines.zh: 我不着急，笑点会自己到
lines.en: No hurry, the punchline arrives on its own
I laugh directly behind you

lines.zh: 你停下的地方正好有回声
lines.en: The place you stopped has an echo

lines.zh: 我的笑声已经把你围住了
lines.en: My laughter has already surrounded you
I laugh and push you
This one is light, truly
You stumbled and I doubled over laughing

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的肩就收了
lines.en: My fingers touched your shoulder and withdrew
I laugh too hard to hit anyone
You bumped into me, funny

lines.zh: 这一下让我的笑更响了
lines.en: That made my laughter louder
No malice, I am only laughing
Laugh once, it will feel better
I hold my belly laughing
I laugh and catch your hem
This one is light as a joke
You were spun around by me

lines.zh: 我的手在你背上拍了一下
lines.en: My hand patted your back once
I was still laughing when I pushed you
Do not take it seriously, it is part of the act
My laughter came first

lines.zh: 你听见的那个笑声不是从门里来的
lines.en: That laughter you heard did not come from the door
I stand laughing under your lamp

lines.zh: 这个世界的笑话太多了
lines.en: This world has too many jokes
I have just finished the first

lines.zh: 六百六十六点，够我笑很久
lines.en: Six hundred sixty-six points, enough to laugh a long while

lines.zh: 我的笑没有回声，这很奇怪
lines.en: My laugh has no echo, which is strange
You are inside, I am outside
Only one wall stands between us

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，你也听见了
lines.en: When I laughed, you heard it too

lines.zh: 笑声从你的门缝下面进来
lines.en: The laughter comes in under your door

lines.zh: 我先笑，然后才站在这里
lines.en: I laughed first, then stood here
You should not be alone

lines.zh: 我把这栋房子的回声调好了
lines.en: I have tuned this house's echo
Listen, all four walls are laughing now
I am here, and so is the joke

lines.zh: 我不占地方，我只需要被听见
lines.en: I take no room, I only need to be heard
This part will be long

lines.zh: 你从床上坐起来了，很好
lines.en: You sat up in bed, good

lines.zh: 我先从最轻的那一声开始
lines.en: I begin with the lightest one
Fire dried my laughter to a rasp

lines.zh: 我掉下去的时候还在笑
lines.en: I was still laughing as I fell

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，笑声变成了泡
lines.en: Water filled my throat and the laugh became bubbles

lines.zh: 爆炸把笑声炸成好几段
lines.en: The blast broke the laughter into pieces

lines.zh: 那东西穿过我，笑声断了一拍
lines.en: It went through me and the laugh skipped a beat

lines.zh: 那股术力把我的声音拉长了
lines.en: That magic stretched my voice out

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只需要有人听
lines.en: I do not eat, I only need someone to listen
In the lightning I laughed louder

lines.zh: 这里连回声都没有，笑不出来了
lines.en: There is not even an echo here, I cannot laugh
